rules.title: Be kind and respectful
rules.body: Treat others the way you want to be treated. Harassment, bullying, and hate speech are not tolerated on Quacky.

rules.title: No spam or unsolicited promotion
rules.body: Do not post repetitive content, unsolicited promotions, or engage in coordinated inauthentic behaviour.

rules.title: No NSFW or inappropriate content
rules.body: Sexually explicit, pornographic, or sexually suggestive content is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Do not share misinformation
rules.body: Do not share content that is widely known to be false or misleading, especially on health, safety, or political topics.

rules.title: Respect intellectual property
rules.body: Credit creators when sharing their work. Do not claim others' content as your own.

rules.title: Protect others' privacy
rules.body: Do not share personal information about others without their consent. No doxxing, surveillance, or stalking.
